title: Director of Information Technology
summary:
GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES
Provides strategic leadership and oversight of all information technology functions across UCS locations and departments, including infrastructure, clinical and business applications, cybersecurity, telecommunications, technical support, and business continuity. Ensures technology is secure, reliable, cost-effective, and aligned with organizational goals and patient care needs.

DIRECT REPORTS: Help Desk Manager and Cybersecurity & Network Specialist. Provides department leadership, establishes priorities, oversees performance, and supports staff development.
responsibilities: Guide IT Leadership, Planning, and Administration
Lead System Integration, Reporting, and Telecommunications

May require work outside regular business hours for system maintenance, upgrades, and urgent technology issues. Position includes remote work three days per week, subject to operational needs. Performs other related duties as assigned.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
Relevant technology, cybersecurity, and project management certifications required.
